messages:
Ava (partnerships): Quick heads-up — AWS/GCP/Azure listing prep. Need to lock down packaging options for initial public listing. Who can take point on SKU naming and trial visibility?
Marcus (product): I can own SKU naming. Thinking two SKUs: pay-as-you-go and reserved (1mo). Need visuals for marketplace tiles though — who on design?
Ava (partnerships): Nice. Design is out this week but we can do a minimal tile. Main ask: make sure trial is discoverable in the marketplace flow (trial checkbox + trial terms link).
Priya (legal): For trials we need a short TOS snippet + link to full EULA. Also confirm region-specific data residency language for Azure private offers. Can Marcus share proposed trial wording?
Marcus (product): Draft: "14-day trial included. Billing starts after trial unless canceled." Short, clear. Will add link placeholder: https://redwood.ai/marketplace-eula
Priya (legal): Ok placeholder good. Need to ensure we capture PII handling note for EU regions: add "Data processed per EU-region controls" line on the tile? Might be too long. Suggest include in full EULA and a badge: "EU data controls"
Derek (eng): FYI technical gating: marketplace listings require an AMI/container manifest and a health-check endpoint for onboarding tests. We should provide a staging endpoint for publisher tests.
Ava (partnerships): Derek can you drop the manifest sample here? We should include it in the publisher starter kit.
Derek (eng): Pasting quick manifest snippet:
```
name: redwood-inference
version: 1.0.0
artifact: gcr.io/redwood/release:v1
health_check: /healthz
regions: [us-west1, eu-west1]
```
Also, we need credentials instructions for the publisher portal (service account + role).
Marcus (product): Good. For UI copy, short tile headline: "Redwood Inference — Production LLM Inference" and subhead: "Low-latency API, reserved capacity, private deployment". CTA: "Start trial". Thoughts?
Ava (partnerships): Clean. Can we also include a short bullets list in the secondary copy: "SLA-backed dedicated pools", "VPC/private deployment" — keep to 2 bullets max.
Priya (legal): One more legal ask: add a link to support SLA doc for Dedicated SKU. Also collect a contact email for entitlements/whitelisting requests.
Ava (partnerships): Use marketplace-support@redwood.ai for onboarding requests. Marcus, can you update the catalog metadata and pass to Derek for artifact hooks?
Marcus (product): Will do. I'll create the metadata JSON and upload to the shared drive. ETA EOD PT.
Derek (eng): I'll validate manifest and healthcheck against marketplace CI tomorrow morning. If we need to tweak the container, ping me in #eng-runtime.
Sam-bot: Marketplace checklist updated: SKU draft complete false -> true; EULA placeholder present; manifest sample uploaded.
Ava (partnerships): Perfect — follow-ups: Marcus to push metadata, Priya to finalize short legal copy, Derek to validate manifest. Let's reconvene after EOD to confirm staging invite for cloud vendor teams. :thumbsup:
Marcus (product): Ack, will ping here when metadata uploaded.
Priya (legal): I'll send the one-paragraph legal blurb by 4pm PT.
Derek (eng): I'll post test endpoint + CI logs when ready.
Ava (partnerships): Thanks team!"
